head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS HCM RBAC filter
change: HCM listener filter chains now decode and enforce envoy.filters.http.rbac.v3.RBAC. The supported grpc-core request-side subset covers any, header, URL-path and and/or/not principals and permissions with ALLOW and DENY policies; one RBAC filter per HCM is accepted. Authenticated/IP/metadata/requested-server-name principals or permissions, destination IP/port/metadata permissions and CEL condition fields are rejected at decode. The listener stores the raw policy, each projection compiles it into its own arena, and evaluation runs before route selection: a denied unary call returns PERMISSION_DENIED without a backend, and a denied streaming open returns error.PermissionDenied.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/lds/rbac.zig covers ALLOW/DENY any-any policies, header and URL-path matching, and rejection of authenticated principals, destination-IP permissions and CEL conditions. src/grpc/xds/lds/tests.zig accepts an RBAC filter before the terminal router and rejects an unsupported principal. src/grpc/xds/lds/controller_tests.zig publishes an inline-RDS listener whose RBAC filter denies requests carrying x-deny and verifies the matching request returns PermissionDenied while an ordinary request still resolves to cluster:a.

notes: Evaluation runs before route selection, matching Envoy's filter order. Header matchers use visible request metadata (including pseudo-headers) and URL-path matchers strip query/fragment through the shared routing matcher. Route/vhost typed_per_filter_config overrides, authenticated/IP/metadata principals, destination IP/port/metadata permissions, requested server names and CEL conditions remain unsupported and are rejected rather than silently allowed. Streaming callers observe error.PermissionDenied on open.
